content_sections.heading: GSVM Medical College, Kanpur Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Office of the Principal, GSVM Medical College, Kanpur, has published Notice No. 2671 dated 3 November 2026 concerning contractual medical teaching faculty vacancies and recurring walk-in interviews. The two-page Hindi notice contains the specialty-wise and designation-wise vacancy roster, remuneration, contractual service conditions, age-related provisions and interview instructions. Official Notification PDF: Download GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026 Notice No. 2671

content_sections.heading: GSVM Medical College Vacancy 2026 - 133 Posts
content_sections.text: The recruitment notice contains 133 contractual medical faculty vacancies across Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor designations. Vacancy Note: The official notice contains a detailed specialty-wise roster with reservation categories and roster numbers. The vacancy totals include positions distributed across different medical specialties and applicable special-category reservations. The notice includes teaching vacancies in several specialties and departments, such as: Orthopaedics Ophthalmology Obstetrics and Gynaecology Emergency Medicine Endocrinology Pathology Anaesthesia Microbiology General Medicine General Surgery Dermatology and Venereology Urology Physiology Forensic Medicine Paediatrics Pharmacology Psychiatry Biochemistry Radiodiagnosis Other specialties identified in the official faculty vacancy roster The available faculty designation and reservation category differ by specialty. Candidates must refer to the official vacancy table before deciding which position they are eligible to attend an interview for.

content_sections.heading: GSVM Medical College Faculty Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the medical qualification, teaching experience and other eligibility conditions applicable to their faculty designation and specialty under the National Medical Commission's Medical Institutions Regulations, 2022, together with the relevant Uttar Pradesh Government service rules. Important: The two-page notice refers candidates to the applicable NMC regulations rather than reproducing a complete specialty-wise qualification chart. Requirements for medical and super-specialty departments may differ. Candidates should verify the qualification applicable to their particular department and faculty rank. Teaching experience requirements depend on the position and applicable NMC faculty eligibility regulations. Professor and Associate Professor appointments are subject to senior faculty experience conditions. Applicants should produce documents proving their previous appointments and qualifying teaching experience wherever required.

content_sections.heading: GSVM Medical College Faculty Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The official notice refers to the age conditions applicable to contractual medical teachers under Uttar Pradesh Government orders. It identifies an upper-age framework for contractual engagement and separate provisions relating to retirement and re-engagement. As these conditions may differ by faculty category and employment status, candidates should read the age-related clauses in the official Hindi notice before attending the interview. Age eligibility should be assessed using the candidate's date of birth, appointment status and the relevant Government order rather than assuming a single age limit applies to all faculty positions.

content_sections.heading: GSVM Medical College Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The notice specifies consolidated monthly remuneration for contractual medical faculty. The three principal designations carry the following amounts. Salary Clarification: These amounts represent the notified remuneration for contractual faculty appointments, not regular Government medical college pay-matrix salaries. The notice also addresses special payment conditions for certain retired or pension-drawing faculty members.

content_sections.heading: GSVM Medical College Contract Period 2026
content_sections.text: Faculty members selected through this process will be engaged on a contractual basis, initially for one year . Extension or termination will be governed by the recruitment notice, the contract and relevant Government provisions. The notice also provides for termination of contractual service under specified conditions.

content_sections.heading: GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026 Application and Interview Process
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted through a walk-in interview . Candidates are required to attend in person with their original certificates and other prescribed records. Important: The PDF mentions a demand draft and related interview-document instructions. Candidates should check the exact amount, payee and supporting requirements in the official Hindi notice before visiting. No payment should be made to an unverified individual or intermediary.

rows.details: Principal's Office, GSVM Medical College, Kanpur

content_sections.heading: How to Attend GSVM Medical College Walk-in Interview 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official GSVM Medical College website at gsvmmedicalcollege.com . Download Notice No. 2671 dated 3 November 2026 . Check the specialty, faculty designation and reservation category in the vacancy table. Read the applicable NMC qualification and teaching experience requirements. Prepare the original educational certificates and teaching experience records. Arrange the prescribed photocopies and other documents required by the notice. Check the demand draft and interview-document instructions in the official PDF. Confirm the latest walk-in schedule and vacancy availability through the official college website. Attend the Principal's Office, GSVM Medical College, Kanpur, on the relevant Friday. Complete the reporting and verification formalities during the notified interview hours. Appear before the selection committee when called. Follow the instructions issued by the college regarding selection results and appointment formalities.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice requires candidates to attend with their original records. Applicants should prepare documents supporting their qualification, experience, identity and applicable reservation claims. Recognized medical degree and postgraduate qualification certificates. Relevant medical specialty or super-specialty qualification documents. Medical registration certificate, as applicable. Teaching experience and previous appointment certificates. Relevant senior faculty promotion or service records, where applicable. Date-of-birth proof. Valid photo identification. Reservation category certificate, where applicable. Recent passport-size photographs. Self-attested photocopies of supporting certificates. Prescribed demand draft or other interview documents, as specified in the notice. Applicants should refer to the official document for the precise submission requirements and should not rely solely on a general checklist.

content_sections.heading: GSVM Medical College Faculty Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted through a walk-in interview before the designated selection committee , subject to verification of required medical qualifications, teaching experience and eligibility conditions. The uploaded notice does not specify a separate written examination, CBT or fixed examination syllabus for this faculty engagement.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 6 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 133 vacancies: 13 Professor, 42 Associate Professor, 70 Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 6 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Professor: maximum 68 years; Associate Professor: maximum 64 years; Assistant Professor: maximum 60 years. Relaxation: Retired medical teachers Maximum 70 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 2,20,000 per month (fixed) for Professor, Rs. 1,60,000 per month (fixed) for Associate Professor, Rs. 1,20,000 per month (fixed) for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Educational qualification and experience as prescribed by the Medical Council of India, Minimum Qualification for Teachers in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2022 and the U.P. State Medical College Teachers Service Rules (Fifth Amendment)-2018. Super speciality posts follow the new NMC guidelines. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No private practice on OPD days. Teachers in private practice must specify the place of private practice. No teacher may compel patients of the attached hospitals to be seen privately. Teachers in private practice must always be available for emergency or disaster services.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview before a selection committee appointed by the Government. Selection by walk-in interview through a selection committee appointed by the Government.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Services end immediately when teachers selected by direct recruitment through the Public Service Commission become available. Service may be ended with one month's notice if not satisfactory. Must join within 30 days of the agreement, else contract stands cancelled.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by GSVM Medical College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: G.S.V.M. Medical College, Kanpur and its Super Speciality Institute (PMSSY), Trauma Centre, Kanpur.
